Aramark Cart Safety Rules
Procedure · OS-7-1 · Form OS-07a-02 · 01/21/22
This Procedure outlines the rules that apply to all persons who operate carts on behalf of Aramark.

Cart Safety Rules:
1. Only employees approved by their direct supervisor may drive carts.
2. All persons who drive electric carts must have a current valid driver's license and Aramark operator's permit.
3. Before employees begin driving carts they are given an orientation to cart operation and the safety rules that are to be followed.
4. Drivers are to slow down or stop at all blind intersections and drive out from doors.
5. Drivers are to drive carefully and courteously and yield to pedestrians or gain the right of way by verbal communication or eye contact.
6. Drivers will conduct Pre-Use Inspection checklist before use each day.
7. Precautions shall be taken to prevent loads from shifting or falling from the cart.
8. Passengers must be in a passenger seat with limbs inside the cart.
9. All accidents shall be reported to the supervisor immediately.
10. Report unsafe conditions to the supervisor immediately.
11. Do not alter the cart's safety equipment.
12. Do not drive while taking medications if the label or your doctor advises against it.
13. After dark always use headlights if the cart is so equipped.
14. There is no "joy riding" or similar non-purposed use.
15. Absolutely no horseplay will be allowed while driving a cart.
16. Take care in where carts are parked so they are not blocking walkways/fire lanes or become an obstacle for people with disabilities.
17. When the rear view is obstructed, do not back up without assistance.
18. Drivers must be responsible, use good judgment, and maintain safe speeds at all times.
19. No unauthorized personnel shall be given rides.
20. These safety rules are to be observed by all employees, not just those who drive carts.
I acknowledge that I have read and received a copy of the Aramark Service Cart Safety Rules and will follow all other applicable rules and regulations.

🎚️ Stand self-login / elevated access
Turn ON when regular staff at this portable/non-main stand may self-run it. A scheduled bartender/student gets temporary stand tools there, and an approved regular NPO member assigned to a portable/non-main stand may self-login with the group PIN + exact roster name. The approved NPO Lead can manage group attendance at every stand assigned to that NPO. This toggle only controls regular-member self-login at portable/non-main stands. Actual Stand Leads, Supervisors and NPO Leads keep their assigned operational access regardless of this toggle.

📅 Upload schedule (ReadyOn CSV)
ReadyOn mapping: Area = stand. Site is the stadium and Location can stay "ASU Athletics". Required: Date, Name, ID, Role, and Area for stand-assigned staff. Blank Area rows are kept as operational areas from Event Name. "Unfilled" rows without an Employee ID are skipped automatically.
👥 Upload warehouse roster (My Team)
Same roster export Warehouse Manager/Supervisor's "My Team" check-in list reads from. Uploading again for the same date replaces it.
🏭 Warehouse walk-in & check-in
Add a walk-in or a new hire to today's warehouse crew, and check people in or out. They sign in with ID 60000 + their last name.
📄 Upload Yellow Dog stand sheet PDF
The "Stand Sheet Pre-Event (All Items)" PDF from Yellow Dog. Each stand's item list is replaced with the PDF's items in the exact same order, names, units, packs and On-Hand / Exp Start — so counting screens, View counts, downloads, print and Yellow Dog copy-paste all follow it. Do it before Count In starts.
📦 Upload inventory (Yellow Dog CSV) older way — use the PDF above when you can
Columns needed: Stand, Item Name, Unit, Pack, Exp Start. Extra columns are OK.
🔄 Roll Count Out → next Exp Start multi-day events only
For a multi-day event using the same inventory: this takes each stand's most recent Count Out and sets it as the Exp Start / On-Hand for the next count — so tonight's closing shelf becomes tomorrow's opening. Only stands that actually submitted a Count Out are changed; everything else is left untouched. Nothing else is altered — this does not delete or re-order any items.
